root_cause_analysis.mechanism: Three interacting failures on grid edge cells (row 0-1, cols 0 and 4): (1) CLN active develops per-cell noise modulation that is 1.6x stronger at edges than center; (2) Edge cells already have 2-5x larger L@eps loadings due to higher IV variance at grid edges; (3) Cell (1,0) specifically develops INVERTED regime response -- L norm turb/calm = 0.58 vs 1.34 average -- producing wider spread in calm than turbulent, causing width_ratio > 2.0
root_cause_analysis.why_167b_passes: With CLN frozen (zero), all per-cell diversity comes through L@eps alone. The load_head learns regime-appropriate loadings because it is the ONLY diversity channel. When CLN is active, CLN competes with L@eps for diversity contribution -- CLN handles bulk diversity (via trunk h variance), while L@eps develops regime-inappropriate edge-cell specialization
root_cause_analysis.why_not_double_diversity: Interaction variance is near zero (0.000033 at worst cell). CLN and L@eps are NOT multiplicatively reinforcing. The problem is COMPETITION for the diversity gradient signal, not additive interaction

hypothesis_verdicts.a_film_amplification: REJECTED - FiLM is global (broadcast), gamma=-0.76 means FiLM ATTENUATES to 24% not amplifies. Cannot cause per-cell divergence.
hypothesis_verdicts.b_L_too_large: PARTIALLY SUPPORTED - L norm at worst cells is 2x average, but this alone does not explain regime inversion at (1,0)
hypothesis_verdicts.c_double_diversity: REJECTED as stated (interaction term near zero), but REFORMULATED as gradient competition: CLN captures bulk diversity, L@eps develops aberrant edge-cell patterns
hypothesis_verdicts.d_insufficient_epochs: REJECTED - 167b also trains 20 epochs with CLN frozen and passes S3

specific_cell_failures.cell_1_4: MAE reduction -51.5%. L norm 1.97x avg. CLN scale 4.03 (highest of all 25 cells). Cell is deep OTM put + 2nd shortest tenor. Conditional mean is wrong direction -- model predicts more spread conditionally than unconditionally but in wrong regime mapping.
specific_cell_failures.cell_1_0: Width ratio 2.001 (>1.20 threshold). L turb/calm = 0.578 (INVERTED -- less loading during turbulence). This means calm windows get more factor noise than turb windows, widening calm CI relative to turb. The test measures turb_width/calm_width, and this cell shows calm_width=0.268 > turb_width=0.150.
specific_cell_failures.cell_2_4: Width ratio 2.001. Similar edge cell. L norm 0.028 (2.3x avg). Huge Leps fraction (0.955) -- almost all variance comes from L@eps, minimal CLN contribution, but L itself is regime-insensitive for this cell.
